round: Review round 15: one important finding, six minor ones, and the forward merge of main through 0642a37a (#2633). The merge (13f952a8) had no conflict and left the file set and the fingerprint unchanged. Two fix commits follow it (b3a91c12, 95ef7808), pushed in one code push. A full round.

proof.criterion: Important: the stored-order check never reports clean over versions a compaction folded below the base
proof.surface: go test of the docs and cmd/dispatch packages, and the real envoy-dispatch stored-order command over a document the real server compacted
proof.command: go test ./internal/dispatch/docs -run '^TestStoredOrder' -args -stored-order-rounds=200; go test ./cmd/dispatch -run StoredOrder; DATABASE_URL=<e2e database> ./envoy-dispatch stored-order --artifact <document> (dispatch://INFRA-593/artifact/infra-593-e2e-proof-txt v24)
proof.observed: All 15 TestStoredOrder* tests pass, including the two new subtests of TestStoredOrderChecker and the second document of TestStoredOrderSubcommandExitCodes. The soak logs rounds=200 mismatching_rounds=0 mismatches=0. On the compacted e2e document the command prints versions_checked=1 versions_compacted=31 with compacted="31 versions record updates below the compaction base 38 and were not compared", clean on the one version it compared (exit 0). On a copy with that version deleted it prints clean=0 unchecked=1 and exits 1.
proof.negativeControl: With the old bucketing and Checked() restored, the new subtests and the CLI case fail: both documents report clean, and the command exits 0 with clean=1 unchecked=0 for a document whose only version is below its base.

Sampled peak 12.20 of 19 GiB over 1,884 samples; the leftover-sampler check printed 0 lines. The e2e run: 41 rows; the restarted process's first sweep logged candidates=1 compacted=1 rows_deleted=37, leaving 4 rows; the 3 young rows are unchanged; the text sha256 is identical; a 31st upload reads back.
proof.negativeControl: At f533f33c, before this merge, the same store suite failed TestMigrationSetTakesNumbersThenTimestamps on main's 0158-0161.

deviations: The checker keeps a version that records update 0 (a document's first, before any row was stored) under versions_skipped rather than versions_compacted: no fold ever reaches it, and counting it would mark every ordinary document as compacted.
The README's stored-order section keeps that section's existing 100-column wrapping, which is main's layout there, rather than one sentence per line.
